Your site, but make it you.妳的網站，就該有妳的樣子

The big picture01 / 08

Three places, three jobs.三個地方，三種工作

Your site lives in three rooms. Learn which one does what, and everything else gets easier.妳的網站住在三個房間裡。搞懂每個房間負責什麼，其他事都會變簡單。

Claude chat · the studio Claude Code · the workshop GitHub · vault + stage

In Claude chat, you decide how things should look: the style, the colors, the mockups, the sprites and sounds. It’s also where you put three hero ideas side by side and pick a favorite.在 Claude 聊天裡，妳決定網站的樣子：風格、顏色、設計稿、角色圖和音效。也可以把三種首屏方案並排比較，挑出最喜歡的。

In Claude Code, those decisions become real HTML and CSS, and a small team of agents checks the work. GitHub keeps every version safe, then puts the finished site on stage for the world.到了 Claude Code，這些決定變成真正的 HTML 和 CSS，還有一支代理小團隊幫妳檢查。GitHub 保存每個版本，再把完成的網站送上舞台。

Your secret weapon

DESIGN.md is one short file listing your audiences, colors, fonts, voice and a “never do” list. Every agent reads it first, so your site never drifts back to generic.DESIGN.md 是一份短短的檔案，寫下客群、配色、字體、語氣和「絕對不做」清單。每個代理都會先讀它，網站就不會退回千篇一律。

A ready-to-fill copy is in your starter kit, page 8.

Decide in chat → build in Code → store in GitHub在聊天裡決定 → 在 Code 裡打造 → 存進 GitHub
The team02 / 08

5 agents who do the boring bits.五個代理，幫妳做雜事

You’re the creative director now. Hire a small team inside Claude Code, give each one a single job, and let them argue with each other instead of with you.現在妳是創意總監。在 Claude Code 裡組一支小團隊，每人只負責一件事，讓他們彼此挑毛病，而不是來煩妳。

designer UX reviewer code reviewer a11y auditor level checker

A subagent is a specialist inside Claude Code. It has its own instructions, its own short list of tools, and a fresh head every time, so the designer isn’t distracted by debugging and the reviewer sees the work with fresh eyes.子代理是 Claude Code 裡的專門人員：有自己的指示、只拿到幾樣工具，每次都從全新的腦袋開始。設計師不會被除錯分心，審查員也能用全新的眼光看作品。

You describe each one once, in a small Markdown file in .claude/agents/. Or skip the typing and just ask: “Create a code-reviewer agent for this project.” From then on, you call them by name.每個代理只要描述一次，寫成 .claude/agents/ 裡的一個小 Markdown 檔。懶得打字就直接說：「幫這個專案建立一個 code-reviewer 代理。」之後叫名字就行了。

Make sure they show up

Claude picks an agent from its description. To call one for certain, mention it:Claude 會依描述挑代理；想確定某位一定出動，就直接點名：

@"code-reviewer (agent)" check the new hero

All five come ready-made in your kit, page 8.五個代理都已放在第 8 頁的工具包裡。

Meet the team認識團隊

ui-designer

Layout, type, color, spacing, icons. Proposes options before touching anything.版面、字體、顏色、間距、圖示。先提案，再動手。

Read · Edit · WritePropose three hero ideas for the Kids page. Don’t edit yet.

ux-reviewer

Walks your page as a busy parent, a shy adult learner or an HR buyer, and finds where they get stuck.扮成忙碌的家長、害羞的成人學員或人資主管逛網頁，找出卡關的地方。

Read onlyCan a busy parent book a trial in three taps?

code-reviewer

Broken links, messy CSS, giant images, sloppy HTML. Reports by severity.壞連結、雜亂的 CSS、超大圖片、草率的 HTML，依嚴重程度回報。

Read · Grep · BashReview everything changed since the last commit.

a11y-auditor

Contrast, alt text, keyboard focus, motion and sound, checked against WCAG.對比、替代文字、鍵盤焦點、動態與音效，以 WCAG 為標準檢查。

Read onlyAudit the Business page against WCAG AA.

level-checker

Makes sure your English matches each audience: A1–A2 for kids, B1 for adults, B2 for business.確認英文符合各客群程度：兒童 A1–A2、成人 B1、商務 B2。

Read onlyIs the Kids page copy A1–A2 friendly?
The working loop工作循環
  1. BriefSay what and who: “Redesign the Business page for HR managers.”交代做什麼、給誰。
  2. ProposeThe designer suggests options. Mock the visual ones up in Claude chat and pick there.設計師提方案；視覺的先在聊天裡做稿再挑。
  3. BuildClaude Code turns your pick into real code.Claude Code 把妳選的寫成程式。
  4. ReviewCode reviewer and a11y auditor at the same time. Two reports, one wait.兩個審查員同時出動，兩份報告只等一次。
  5. Look, then commitYou check it in the browser first. Then it’s saved.自己先在瀏覽器看過，才存檔。
A reviewer that can’t edit has nothing to defend.不能動手改的審查員，沒有東西要護短。

Give reviewers read-only tools. The agent that wrote the code tends to approve its own work; a separate reviewer just tells you the truth.給審查員只能讀的工具。寫程式的代理容易認可自己的作品，獨立的審查員只會跟妳說實話。

Try a branch. For big experiments: “Try a pixel-art theme on a new branch called pixel-test.” Hate it? Delete the branch; your real site never changed.大型實驗開新分支，不喜歡就整個刪掉，正式網站完全沒動到。
Art direction03 / 08

Make a mascot only you have.做一個只屬於妳的吉祥物

Stock icons make every school look the same. Six tools turn “an icon of a book” into a character, a sound and a little film that could only be yours.現成圖示讓每間補習班都長得一樣。六種工具能把「一個書本圖示」變成只屬於妳的角色、音效和短片。

Each tool is a tiny drawing or sound language. You describe what you want in plain English, Claude writes the recipe, and the tool renders real files: PNG, SVG, 3D models, sound, video. Then you ask for changes until it feels right.每種工具都是一個小小的繪圖或聲音語言。妳用一般英文描述想要的，Claude 寫出「食譜」，工具輸出真正的檔案：PNG、SVG、3D 模型、音效、影片。接著一直要求修改，直到感覺對了為止。

They were built for games, which is exactly why they make a teaching site feel playful instead of corporate. Turn them on in your Claude account first.它們本來是為遊戲而做的，所以正好能讓教學網站變得活潑，而不是一板一眼。記得先在 Claude 帳號裡開啟這些技能。

Icon rules

Plain icons for menu, search and close: people need to recognize them instantly.選單、搜尋、關閉用一般圖示，大家要一眼認得。

Characters for moments: the hero, rewards, empty pages.角色留給特別時刻：首屏、獎勵、空白頁。

One style family per site, every size the same weight.整個網站只用一個風格家族。

The six tools六種工具

pxl pixel art

Sprites, badges and sprite sheets. A waving mascot, “lesson complete” badges, level shields from A1 to C1.角色、徽章、精靈圖表：揮手的吉祥物、完成課程徽章、A1 到 C1 的等級盾牌。

A 32×32 owl teacher in a red scarf, 4-frame waving sprite sheet.

vex vector art

The best icon replacement: sharp at any size, tiny files, easy to recolor. Every drawing in this magazine was made with it.最適合取代圖示：放多大都清楚、檔案小、好換色。這本雜誌裡的插畫都是用它畫的。

12 lesson-topic icons, same line weight: travel, interview, phonics…

kiln 3D models

Low-poly or voxel objects. Use a render as hero art, or let visitors spin the model.低多邊形或方塊風 3D 物件，可當首屏插畫，也能讓訪客旋轉。

A low-poly desk with a globe, an open book and a coffee cup.

chirp sound

A soft “ding” for a right answer, a page-turn on flashcards, a jingle for videos. Always off until the visitor turns sound on.答對的「叮」、翻字卡聲、影片配樂。訪客開啟音效前一律靜音。

A gentle two-note success chime, under 0.4 seconds, warm marimba.

loom textures

Quiet background surfaces: chalkboard for Kids, linen paper for Adults, slate for Business.低調的背景材質：兒童用黑板、成人用麻紙、商務用石板。

A seamless recycled-paper texture, very low contrast.

reel video

Trailers and vertical shorts cut to the beat of your music: a course teaser, a summer-camp reel.依音樂節拍剪輯的預告和直式短片：課程預告、夏令營短片。

A 20-second vertical teaser for Kids Summer Camp from these sprites.
The owl, frame by frame貓頭鷹，一格一格看

owl-wave.png · 128 × 32 px · four frames

  1. rest
  2. raise
  3. wave!
  4. lower

A sprite sheet is all the frames of an animation side by side in one image. On your page, CSS slides it along one frame at a time.精靈圖表就是把動畫影格並排在一張圖上，CSS 一次滑動一格。

.mascot {
  width: 64px; height: 64px;
  background: url(img/owl-wave.png)
              0 0 / 256px 64px;
  image-rendering: pixelated;
  animation: wave .6s steps(4) infinite;
}
@keyframes wave {
  to { background-position: -256px 0; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .mascot { animation: none; }   /* respect it */
}
Watch · from idea to a waving owl示範影片：從一句話到揮手的貓頭鷹
Behind the scenes04 / 08

GitHub, decoded.GitHub 一次看懂

Two jobs, one account. The vault keeps every version of your site safe. The stage puts it in front of the world, for free.一個帳號，兩種用途。保險庫保存網站的每個版本；舞台免費把它展示給全世界。

your laptop the vault · private repo the stage · Pages

The vault

Every commit is a save point. Every push sends your save points up to a private repository. Laptop dies? Nothing lost.每次提交就是一個存檔點；每次推送就把存檔點送上私人儲存庫。筆電壞了也不會掉任何東西。

You never have to learn the commands. Just ask Claude Code:妳不用學指令，直接跟 Claude Code 說：

Set up git and a private GitHub repo for this project, then push. 
# what it runs for you
git init
git add .
git commit -m "First version"
gh repo create my-site --private --source=. --push

Don’t want the code on your laptop at all? Claude Code can also work in the cloud, right on your GitHub repo.連筆電都不想放程式碼？Claude Code 也能在雲端直接處理 GitHub 儲存庫。

The stage

  1. In your repo, open Settings → Pages.在儲存庫打開 Settings → Pages。
  2. Source: Deploy from a branch. Branch main, folder / (root).選擇從 main 分支、根目錄部署。
  3. About a minute later you’re live at you.github.io/my-site.大約一分鐘後就上線了。
  4. Own domain? Add it under Pages, update your DNS, tick Enforce HTTPS.自訂網域：在 Pages 加上網域、更新 DNS、勾選 Enforce HTTPS。
The catch. On the free plan, Pages publishes from public repos only; a private repo needs a paid plan. Either way, the website itself is public.免費方案只能從公開儲存庫發佈，私人儲存庫要付費。不管哪一種，網站本身都是公開的。
Two small habits兩個小習慣
✕/img/owl.png

A slash at the start breaks images on a Pages project site, because it lives in a sub-folder.開頭有斜線，專案網站的圖片就會壞掉，因為網站在子資料夾裡。

✓img/owl.png

Relative paths work everywhere: on your laptop and on stage.相對路徑在哪裡都能用。

✕passwords · keys · student lists

Never commit them. The kit’s .gitignore blocks the usual suspects.絕對不要提交；工具包的 .gitignore 會擋掉常見的機密檔案。

Masterclass05 / 08

10 design rules pros never break.專業設計師絕不打破的十條規則

Name an idea and you can ask Claude for it exactly. Better still, you’ll spot the moment a draft gets it wrong.叫得出名字，就能精準地跟 Claude 要；更棒的是，草稿一出錯妳馬上看得出來。

01
123

Hierarchy

What does the eye see first, second, third? One main message and one main button per screen.層級：眼睛先看什麼、再看什麼？每個畫面一個主訊息、一個主按鈕。

02
BIGsmalldarkpale

Contrast

Big against small, bold against light, dark against pale. If everything is medium, nothing stands out.對比：大配小、粗配細、深配淺。全部中等，就沒有重點。

03
Aa+Aadisplay · body

Typography

Pair a display face with personality and a calm body face. Lines of 60–70 characters. Make the Chinese font match the mood too.字體：有個性的標題字配平穩的內文字，每行 60–70 字元，中文字體也要搭。

04
60 calm30 support10 accent

Color

The 60–30–10 rule: a calm main color, a supporting color, and one accent saved for buttons.60–30–10 法則：六成主色、三成輔助色、一成重點色留給按鈕。

05

Spacing

Pick one scale (4, 8, 16, 24, 40, 64) and use nothing else. Whitespace is what makes a page look expensive.間距：只用一套尺度。留白讓頁面看起來有質感。

06

Grid & alignment

Everything lines up with something. Left-aligned text reads faster than centered.網格與對齊：每樣東西都對齊某樣東西；靠左比置中好讀。

07
--brand: #d81b72;--space-3: 16px;

Consistency

Same button, same card, same icon style everywhere. Design tokens make it automatic for you and for Claude.一致性：到處用同樣的按鈕和圖示風格，設計變數讓它自動完成。

08

Imagery

Photos, illustrations and icons share one look. A real photo of you teaching beats any stock photo.圖像：照片、插畫、圖示同一種風格。妳上課的真實照片勝過任何圖庫照。

09
explain · reward · stop

Motion

Animate to explain or reward: a card flips to show the answer, a badge pops when a lesson is done. Short, and it can be switched off.動態：用來說明或獎勵，要短，而且可以關掉。

10
Aa 7.2 : 1 ✓Aa 2.1 : 1 ✕

Accessibility

Text contrast at least 4.5:1, tap targets about 44 px, alt text on images, visible keyboard focus. The rulebook is called WCAG.無障礙：對比至少 4.5:1、按鈕約 44 像素、圖片有替代文字、焦點看得見。這套規範叫 WCAG。

Taste comes from you. Claude just turns it into rules.品味來自妳，Claude 只是把它變成規則。
Style file06 / 08

Dress each page for who’s reading.為每一種讀者打扮網頁

A style is a set of choices that travel together: fonts, colors, shapes, buttons. Name one and Claude makes a hundred small decisions for you. Try them on.風格就是一組成套出現的選擇：字體、顏色、形狀、按鈕。叫出名字，Claude 就替妳做好上百個小決定。來試穿看看。

Makeover07 / 08

The 7-step site makeover.七步驟網站大改造

Same school, same words, seven decisions. From “could be anyone” to “that’s so you.”同一間學校、同樣的內容，做七個決定。從「誰都可以是」到「這就是妳」。

  1. Pick one audience per page. A page for everyone persuades no one.每頁只選一種客群。寫給所有人的頁面，誰也說服不了。
  2. Rewrite the headline as a result. Not “Learn English,” but what changes in their life.把標題寫成成果，而不是口號。
  3. Choose a named style and 4–6 colors. Write them into your tokens.選一個有名字的風格和 4–6 個顏色，寫進設計變數。
  4. Change the fonts. This one step changes the feel more than any other.換字體：這一步對感覺的影響最大。
  5. Swap stock icons for your own art. Or delete them if they add nothing.用自己的美術取代現成圖示，沒用就刪掉。
  6. Add one signature element. A mascot, a texture, a handwritten note, a bold number row. Only one.加一個招牌元素，而且只加一個。
  7. Cut. Delete every section, badge and sentence that doesn’t help the visitor decide.刪減：不能幫訪客做決定的通通刪掉。
A prompt that works“Restyle the Business page in a Swiss International style for HR managers in Taiwan. Navy, white and one teal accent. Left-aligned, strict grid. Replace the icon tiles with a row of three real numbers. Follow DESIGN.md’s voice rules. Show me the plan before editing.”

Don’t look like everyone else.別跟大家長得一樣

When you give no direction, AI reaches for the same safe choices. Spot them, then name something else.沒給方向時，AI 會選同一套保險的做法。認出它們，然後指定別的。

  • Purple-to-blue gradients
  • Everything centered
  • Emoji as icons
  • The same rounded cards
  • “Unlock your potential”
  • Stock photos of strangers

Feed it references

Collect 5–10 screenshots you love: sites, book covers, packaging, posters. Ask Claude what they share and turn it into a style brief.收集 5–10 張喜歡的截圖，問 Claude 共同點，變成風格說明。

Nouns, not adjectives

“Modern and clean” means nothing. “A Japanese stationery shop: kraft paper, red stamps, grid notebooks” gives Claude a whole world.用名詞描述，不要用形容詞。

Write your own words

Let AI edit, not author, your About page. Your stories and opinions are the one thing nobody can copy.關於我讓 AI 潤稿，別讓它代寫。妳的故事和觀點別人抄不走。

Bilingual, done right

Mark lang="zh-Hant-TW" and lang="en". Pick a Chinese font that matches the English mood, and load only the weights you use.正確標記語言；中文字體只載入用得到的字重。

No server needed

A booking link (Calendly or Cal.com), a form service, a LINE Official Account button, privacy-friendly analytics.預約連結、表單服務、LINE 官方帳號按鈕、重視隱私的流量分析。

Share-ready

Every page gets a title, a description and a 1200×630 preview image, so links look good in LINE and Threads.每頁都要有標題、描述和 1200×630 預覽圖。

Speed check

Compress images to WebP, lazy-load what’s below the fold, and run a Lighthouse check before each launch.圖片轉 WebP、延遲載入，上線前跑一次 Lighthouse。

Rights & privacy

No famous cartoon characters. Check font licenses. Get written permission before showing students’ faces or work.不用知名卡通角色、確認字體授權，學生的臉和作品要先取得書面同意。
